post.title: Fence Installation Lake Forest Park WA — Height Limits, When a Permit Applies, Property Lines and Rot-Resistant Posts
post.description: A Lake Forest Park homeowner's guide to building a fence: the city's 4-foot and 6-foot height rules, when a fence or retaining wall needs a building permit, sight distance triangles, property lines, Washington's call-before-you-dig law, and posts that last in Northwest rain.
